opening.name: Opening seconds
opening.rule: Nothing can hurt in the first ~3-5 s of plain walking; the first tip comes before the first hazard it teaches.

plainWalk.name: Plain walk
plainWalk.rule: No step, lip or dip that stops a plain walk dead; every dip has a one-jump way out; a jump into a face carries over its lip.

eagle.name: 1-7's eagle
eagle.rule: The first swoop must be a harmless warning; swoops come from on screen or with a clear tell; hiding works the way a thumb naturally does it.

dot.name: Dot pacing
dot.rule: A gap of ~10-12 s between her lines (a warning just before a danger and a locked-exit explanation aside); no repeating a tip once done; no re-teaching moves already used; under 10 words.

wayOn.name: Way on
wayOn.rule: A first-timer going the way the stage leads is never stopped 8 s with no progress (outside a puzzle).

outcome.name: First-timer outcome
outcome.rule: A first-timer reaches the shrine without losing lives over and over.

survival.name: Hotspots (survival per jump)
survival.rule: Every jump edge is crossed without a fall or a hit by 85% of tries on Easy, 70% on Normal (Worlds 1-5).

window.name: Minimum input window
window.rule: No jump needs its press within less than 300 ms on Easy (9 frames), 167 ms on Normal (5 frames).

stress.name: Peak stress per burst
stress.rule: The risk of the jumps in one burst before a rest adds up to 2.5 at most on Easy, 5.5 on Normal.

backtrack.name: Backtracking ratio
backtrack.rule: The path is 1.0-1.25 times the straight line from start to shrine on Easy, 1.15-1.6 on Normal.
